book.name: Aposelo
book.title: APOSELO Aposelo Ali-kitame Yesunole Takama Yakete Tanemo

content: Poloyo Yerusaleme Yu Yene-pala Akenemo
Ame atai-loe pinali anu kei piane oatekumo ukuno, yakoe wa okale
yatekete ekete ekee i agome tone Iberu agaleke eni oko wa agale te̱itoa wawa kakoli okome

nopa Yu ago Silisia ta keneke piko Tasase take opianeyake Yerusaleme take tubetoane kakene eya ago Gamelielene sukilike pokouya. Einago Gamelieleyo tone kaua-mikitame litia toma nekene totono litia olaukatapekale yakoane tokou. Nipa kime Akolalinele wedoa takama niki toane noanumeka wedoane takama nuku.
Nitikenepa i weneya totono litia tiki yene tete meane wiane tukoane alika atoaka kebetoane po yapu pitikoane tokou.

Kipala i ukumopa ako odene mekome Akolalike lodo yotokoai toko tobou agomeka ete Kanosolo ali peyameka no einagome nimini eni oko wa no kei pia amele toko. Eni tobou ali-kitame kini oya-mikiti Damasikase take mekika i pipia meamene wa pipia wia metekoli moomotekene Damasikase take pokou. Nipa weneya totono litia tiki-kiti kibu momotoane oto Yerusaleme take liane auane nou wane pokou.
Damasikase take poadene pekene tigotokakoane witapokouta lou mataike pene kelema ponokale a tibuke pa̱ toa kaka matiyame keti to̱awineya nome no ewetemoa pikale
itonoke auane pitakene yatekolu padame agale okome okome Solo Solo no edeyake tete mekala toko-pe wa okale
yatekene ekene Ali Muno nepa te kake oko-pe-kolu okome neme tete mekala tokago Nasarese Yesuyo uku wa oka.
Nitikake nopala opia nokoi ali-kitame eni toka pa̱ eneketeke nopala agale oa kakamo yakamokoi.

E yename yakamokolika ekene Ali Muno anume edele tomotoa oko-pe-kolu okome Damasikase take poke mepamene. Poke mekale neke toatekale Akolaliyo kotukapikale-kama i i wa panagome nokome oono, wete kamoa poano pa wa oka.
Eni toka pa̱me anu leneta likaneya tokome nopala opia nokoi ali-kitame anu yono moa aua pote Damasikase take mekapokoi.
Eni takepa Mosesene totono wedoa litia tokago Ananaiasi meaneya. Damasikase Yu yene peyame one kei piai taneya.
Einago no mekouta nokome okome ame Solo neke leneta wa kikoa ena wa okaka eina eina leneta kikakatapeneya enekolu einago kakale enekou.

Nitikolu okome ame tone kaua-mikitane Akolaliyopa eya tomotoa ne moa kakapianeya. One wene pikole wene toa toa ni wene ki̱yo akeneya-kama mekago enoa ni einagome nepala agale a̱wa okale yakoa tomotoa tokome ne moa kakapianeya.
Nitaneyano, neke leneme enoa kaleme yakoa tokanakamo ali atoa pitikoi toa pima yake i i wa akama poo.
Edoa ita nepia meade-pe. Neke poanele ko̱a mitikakamotono, Yesuno ibini wedekoa ue moamene. Wete kamoa wa Ananaiasiyo oa poka.
Nitaneyake Yerusaleme wakapeane none mekou. None mekene tobou losu yapu pone kowitikoane kakene pulete keneya enekolu
Ali Muno no kakouta nokome okome anukumo neme oa metekolo i take meki-kitame yakamadete wakino, i ta wete tewitikoa pa-kale ekene
Ali Muno papete losu yapu kaka toane pikilepa neeke wene tugoa mekoi-kiti po wapime wiane po yapu pitikoane toadene tokouno, i take meki-kitame anu eni toma yakounakamo yatekete tokoi.

Neke agale akama pokago Sitipane ete Yu yename wia tukakoina-pete noka e yene-pala opiane kakene oyakeno toe wane eya tokou. E Yu yename einago wia tukadete kini tokoo mamina kotokoa pitikakoita eni mamina nepikoane kakou wane Ali Muno-pala okou.
Nimo okolu okome e ku pa yatene ta tetemada mekika ne pa wane ne wetekouno, wete pa wa Ali Munoyo nopala oka wa Poloyo oka.
Onepa Lomane Yatene Ago
Wa Polo Pinali One Wa Kei Pianemo
Poloyo agale okoa kakale e Yu yename yakakoa meaneyake one wipitikome okale yatekete agale telo oa kamotokakete ekete i agopa katekoa wato. Wete wia tukato wa ka̱ oa kakoi.
Nitikete kini tokoo kakene mamina kotokoa kogoa itono kugue-pala moa ate tadekoa tokoi.
Nitikakoa ako tobou poyo agome okome Yu yename i ago-pala wene pokete u̱u kayo oa kakino, one tanemo tete nakome omotono, tone a yapu aua pote layo toua wipoe wa oa poka.

Nitikale e poyo ali-kitame aida aua pekete wiadete kebetelogakili Poloyo kiwi yopikago one lutukoiya liti kakale eya wa yateka. Lomane yatene agopa one tanemo-kiti koiso yopikagome wete pitia yakameneyake oyake layo toua wiamele toko-pe wa okale
yakamotokome einagome ako tobou poyo ago mekata wete pokome okome mone i agopa Lomane yatene ago tadekono, edoa layo toua wimotoa-pe wa okale
tobou ago Polo kakata nokome yatekome okome nepa Lomane yatene ago-pe-kale okome e̱eno, nopa Lomane ago kaku-kale okome
ae nopa pa yatene ago opianeyake tubetoane kakene Lomane yatene ago latiadene kue peya mati metekou wa okale Poloyo okome Lomane agome no opianeya wa oka.
Nimo okalepa one pitia yakatekoi ali-kiti ete witimoa kakoi. Ako tobou poyo agoka i agopa Lomane yatene agoke kapa po kakakou wa pitime tuaneya kaka.
Polo Kanosolo Yenane Lene Yoto Kakenemo

Podolikama ako poyo tobou agome eya toka. I agome edele taneyake Yu yename akoa agale ikiti patuno, pine to̱ane pitiane yakou wa Polo kakane kapa po kotokaka. Nitoapa Akolalike lodo yotokoai tane tobou ali-kiti ete Kanosolo ali peya koukoa noe wa agale oa wetekakale koukoa note mekoli Polo moa aua pome kini lene yoto kakapoka.
